name: Photophobia
source:
You play as a ghost who is weak to light, make your way through the Haunted Manor to take part in a party and meet some ghost friends!

[from [url=https://cranberry-shortcake.itch.io/photophobia]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你將扮演一隻怕光的幽靈，穿過鬧鬼的莊園，去參加派對，結交幾位幽靈朋友！

［摘自[url=https://cranberry-shortcake.itch.io/photophobia]itch.io[/url]］
